```{r load_data_if_needed, include=FALSE}
# Helper function: Robust date parser
as_date_safe <- function(x) {
  v <- as.character(x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  out <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(v))
  is_serial <- !is.na(num) & num > 20000 & num < 60000
  out[is_serial] <- as.Date(num[is_serial], origin = "1899-12-30")
  left <- !is.na(num) & !is_serial
  if (any(left)) {
    parsed <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(v[left], orders = c("Y-m-d","m/d/Y","d/m/Y","m/d/y","d/m/y","Ymd"), tz = "UTC"))
    out[left] <- as.Date(parsed)
  }
  bad <- is.na(out) | year(out) < 2000 | year(out) > 2100
  out[bad] <- as.Date(NA)
  out
}

# Build long ctDNA data from wide columns
build_ctdna_long <- function(dat, id_col) {
  cat("  Building ctdna_long from", nrow(dat), "rows in dat...\n")
  
  ctdna_value_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  ctdna_date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  
  cat("  Found", length(ctdna_value_cols), "ctDNA value columns and", length(ctdna_date_cols), "ctDNA date columns\n")
  
  if (length(ctdna_value_cols) == 0 || length(ctdna_date_cols) == 0) {
    cat("  Warning: Missing ctDNA columns. Returning empty tibble.\n")
    return(tibble(
      !!id_col := character(0),
      ctdna_date = as.Date(character(0)),
      ctdna_value = numeric(0)
    ))
  }
  
  # Check how many patients we have
  n_patients_before <- length(unique(dat[[id_col]]))
  cat("  Starting with", n_patients_before, "unique patients\n")
  
  val <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), all_of(ctdna_value_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp", values_to = "ctdna_value_raw") %>%
    mutate(ctdna_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", gsub(",", "", as.character(ctdna_value_raw))))))
  
  cat("  After pivoting values:", nrow(val), "rows\n")
  cat("  Non-NA values:", sum(!is.na(val$ctdna_value)), "\n")
  
  dt  <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), all_of(ctdna_date_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp_date", values_to = "ctdna_date_raw")
  
  cat("  After pivoting dates:", nrow(dt), "rows\n")
  
  out <- val %>%
    mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp, "\\d+"))) %>%
    left_join(dt %>% mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp_date, "\\d+"))) %>% select(all_of(id_col), tp_idx, ctdna_date_raw),
              by = c(id_col, "tp_idx")) %>%
    mutate(ctdna_date = as_date_safe(ctdna_date_raw))
  
  cat("  After joining:", nrow(out), "rows\n")
  cat("  Non-NA dates:", sum(!is.na(out$ctdna_date)), "\n")
  cat("  Rows with both date and value:", sum(!is.na(out$ctdna_date) & !is.na(out$ctdna_value)), "\n")
  
  # Filter - allow rows with at least a date OR a value (not requiring both)
  out <- out %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_date) | !is.na(ctdna_value)) %>%
    # If value is NA but date exists, set value to 0 (assuming negative)
    mutate(ctdna_value = ifelse(is.na(ctdna_value) & !is.na(ctdna_date), 0, ctdna_value)) %>%
    # If date is NA but value exists, we can't use it, so filter out
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_date)) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), ctdna_date, ctdna_value) %>%
    arrange(.data[[id_col]], ctdna_date)
  
  n_patients_after <- length(unique(out[[id_col]]))
  cat("  Final result:", nrow(out), "rows from", n_patients_after, "patients\n")
  
  out
}

# Check if required objects exist, if not load data using EXACT approach from ctDNA_Descriptive.Rmd
if (!exists("ctdna_long") || is.null(ctdna_long) || nrow(ctdna_long) == 0) {
  cat("Note: ctdna_long not found. Loading data using approach from ctDNA_Descriptive.Rmd...\n")
  
  # Load data EXACTLY as in ctDNA_Descriptive.Rmd
  # Lower tract dataset
  file_path_lower <- "Natera_Sheet_Master1.xlsx"
  if (file.exists(file_path_lower)) {
    cat("Loading lower tract data from", file_path_lower, "\n")
    available_sheets_lower <- excel_sheets(file_path_lower)
    sheet_name_lower <- if ("Master_Sheet" %in% available_sheets_lower) {
      "Master_Sheet"
    } else if ("Sheet1" %in% available_sheets_lower) {
      "Sheet1"
    } else {
      available_sheets_lower[1]
    }
    raw_lower <- read_excel(file_path_lower, sheet = sheet_name_lower, col_names = FALSE)
    var_names_lower <- raw_lower[[1]]
    dat_lower <- as.data.frame(t(raw_lower[, -1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(dat_lower) <- make.unique(var_names_lower, sep = "_")
    dat_lower <- clean_names(dat_lower)
    
    # Identify patient ID column
    id_col_lower <- if ("record_id_linking_key" %in% names(dat_lower)) {
      "record_id_linking_key"
    } else {
      id_candidates <- names(dat_lower)[str_detect(names(dat_lower), regex("record.*id|id.*linking|linking.*key", ignore_case = TRUE))]
      if (length(id_candidates) > 0) id_candidates[1] else names(dat_lower)[2]
    }
    
    # Filter blank IDs
    dat_lower <- dat_lower %>%
      mutate(id_check = as.character(.data[[id_col_lower]])) %>%
      filter(!is.na(id_check), str_trim(id_check) != "", str_trim(id_check) != "NA") %>%
      select(-id_check)
    
    dat_lower$dataset <- "Lower Tract"
    dat_lower <- dat_lower %>% rename(patient_id = all_of(id_col_lower))
    cat("  Lower tract: ", nrow(dat_lower), "patients\n")
  } else {
    cat("Warning: ", file_path_lower, "not found. Skipping lower tract data.\n")
    dat_lower <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), dataset = character(0))
  }
  
  # Upper tract dataset
  file_path_upper <- "Natera_Sheet_UTUC.xlsx"
  if (file.exists(file_path_upper)) {
    cat("Loading upper tract data from", file_path_upper, "\n")
    raw_upper <- read_excel(file_path_upper, sheet = "Sheet1", col_names = FALSE)
    var_names_upper <- raw_upper[[1]]
    dat_upper <- as.data.frame(t(raw_upper[, -1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(dat_upper) <- make.unique(var_names_upper, sep = "_")
    dat_upper <- clean_names(dat_upper)
    
    # Identify patient ID column
    id_col_upper <- if ("record_id_linking_key" %in% names(dat_upper)) {
      "record_id_linking_key"
    } else {
      id_candidates <- names(dat_upper)[str_detect(names(dat_upper), regex("record.*id|id.*linking|linking.*key", ignore_case = TRUE))]
      if (length(id_candidates) > 0) id_candidates[1] else names(dat_upper)[2]
    }
    
    # Filter blank IDs
    dat_upper <- dat_upper %>%
      mutate(id_check = as.character(.data[[id_col_upper]])) %>%
      filter(!is.na(id_check), str_trim(id_check) != "", str_trim(id_check) != "NA") %>%
      select(-id_check)
    
    dat_upper$dataset <- "Upper Tract"
    dat_upper <- dat_upper %>% rename(patient_id = all_of(id_col_upper))
    cat("  Upper tract: ", nrow(dat_upper), "patients\n")
  } else {
    cat("Warning: ", file_path_upper, "not found. Skipping upper tract data.\n")
    dat_upper <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), dataset = character(0))
  }
  
  # Convert date columns
  date_cols_lower <- names(dat_lower)[str_detect(names(dat_lower), regex("date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  date_cols_upper <- names(dat_upper)[str_detect(names(dat_upper), regex("date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  
  if (length(date_cols_lower) > 0) {
    dat_lower <- dat_lower %>% mutate(across(all_of(date_cols_lower), as_date_safe))
  }
  if (length(date_cols_upper) > 0) {
    dat_upper <- dat_upper %>% mutate(across(all_of(date_cols_upper), as_date_safe))
  }
  
  # Normalize ctDNA column names
  names(dat_lower) <- str_replace_all(names(dat_lower), regex("^ct[_ ]?dna[_ ]?level(\\d+)$", ignore_case = TRUE), "ct_dna_level_\\1")
  names(dat_upper) <- str_replace_all(names(dat_upper), regex("^ct[_ ]?dna[_ ]?level(\\d+)$", ignore_case = TRUE), "ct_dna_level_\\1")
  
  # Ensure ctDNA numeric columns are numeric
  ctdna_value_cols_lower <- names(dat_lower)[str_detect(names(dat_lower), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(ctdna_value_cols_lower)) {
    dat_lower[ctdna_value_cols_lower] <- lapply(dat_lower[ctdna_value_cols_lower], function(x) {
      y <- gsub(",", "", as.character(x))
      y <- gsub("^<\\s*", "", y)
      y[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", "Not detected", "Undetected", "NEGATIVE", "Negative", "neg", "ND")] <- NA
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
    })
  }
  
  ctdna_value_cols_upper <- names(dat_upper)[str_detect(names(dat_upper), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(ctdna_value_cols_upper)) {
    dat_upper[ctdna_value_cols_upper] <- lapply(dat_upper[ctdna_value_cols_upper], function(x) {
      y <- gsub(",", "", as.character(x))
      y <- gsub("^<\\s*", "", y)
      y[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", "Not detected", "Undetected", "NEGATIVE", "Negative", "neg", "ND")] <- NA
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
    })
  }
  
  # Find common columns for combining
  common_cols <- intersect(names(dat_lower), names(dat_upper))
  cat("Common columns:", length(common_cols), "\n")
  
  # Combine datasets
  dat_combined <- bind_rows(
    dat_lower %>% select(all_of(common_cols), dataset),
    dat_upper %>% select(all_of(common_cols), dataset)
  )
  
  cat("Combined dataset: ", nrow(dat_combined), "patients total\n")
  cat("  - Lower tract:", sum(dat_combined$dataset == "Lower Tract"), "\n")
  cat("  - Upper tract:", sum(dat_combined$dataset == "Upper Tract"), "\n")
  
  # Build ctDNA long data
  ctdna_long <- build_ctdna_long(dat_combined, "patient_id")
  cat("Created ctdna_long with", nrow(ctdna_long), "rows from", length(unique(ctdna_long$patient_id)), "patients\n")
}

# Check if survival_outcomes exists, if not create it using EXACT approach from ctDNA_Descriptive.Rmd
if (!exists("survival_outcomes") || is.null(survival_outcomes) || nrow(survival_outcomes) == 0) {
  cat("Note: survival_outcomes not found. Creating using approach from ctDNA_Descriptive.Rmd...\n")
  
  # Extract survival data function (from ctDNA_Descriptive.Rmd)
  extract_survival_data <- function(dat, id_col_name) {
    # Get relapse date
    relapse_date <- NULL
    relapse_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date|progression.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(relapse_cols) > 0) {
      relapse_data <- dat %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(relapse_cols[1])) %>%
        rename(relapse_date_raw = all_of(relapse_cols[1])) %>%
        mutate(relapse_date = as_date_safe(relapse_date_raw)) %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), relapse_date)
      relapse_date <- relapse_data
    }
    
    # Get explicit death date
    explicit_death_date <- NULL
    death_date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                   !str_detect(names(dat), regex("cause|reason", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
      death_date_data <- dat %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(death_date_cols[1])) %>%
        rename(death_date_raw = all_of(death_date_cols[1])) %>%
        mutate(explicit_death_date = as_date_safe(death_date_raw)) %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), explicit_death_date)
      explicit_death_date <- death_date_data
    }
    
    # Get survival/follow-up date
    survival_date <- NULL
    survival_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                !str_detect(names(dat), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(survival_cols) > 0) {
      survival_data <- dat %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(survival_cols[1])) %>%
        rename(survival_date_raw = all_of(survival_cols[1])) %>%
        mutate(survival_date = as_date_safe(survival_date_raw)) %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), survival_date)
      survival_date <- survival_data
    }
    
    # Get alive yes/no status
    alive_status <- NULL
    alive_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^alive_yes_no$|alive.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(alive_cols) > 0) {
      alive_data <- dat %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(alive_cols[1])) %>%
        rename(alive_status_raw = all_of(alive_cols[1])) %>%
        mutate(
          alive_yes_no = case_when(
            str_detect(tolower(as.character(alive_status_raw)), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
            str_detect(tolower(as.character(alive_status_raw)), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
          )
        ) %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), alive_yes_no)
      alive_status <- alive_data
    }
    
    # Get death status (legacy)
    death_status <- NULL
    death_status_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("death|died|vital.*status", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                   !str_detect(names(dat), regex("date|alive", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(death_status_cols) > 0) {
      death_data <- dat %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(death_status_cols[1])) %>%
        rename(death_status_raw = all_of(death_status_cols[1])) %>%
        mutate(
          death_status_legacy = case_when(
            str_detect(tolower(as.character(death_status_raw)), "yes|dead|died|death|deceased") ~ 1,
            TRUE ~ 0
          )
        ) %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), death_status_legacy)
      death_status <- death_data
    }
    
    # Extract palliative therapy start dates
    palliative_dates <- NULL
    therapy_setting_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*setting", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    therapy_start_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*start.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    
    if (length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0 && length(therapy_start_cols) > 0) {
      therapy_settings_long <- dat %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
        pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "setting") %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_idx = str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"),
          setting_lower = tolower(as.character(setting))
        ) %>%
        filter(str_detect(setting_lower, "palliative"))
      
      therapy_starts_long <- dat %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_start_cols)) %>%
        pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_idx = str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"),
          start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw)
        ) %>%
        filter(!is.na(start_date))
      
      palliative_dates <- therapy_settings_long %>%
        left_join(therapy_starts_long, by = c(id_col_name, "therapy_idx")) %>%
        filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
        group_by(.data[[id_col_name]]) %>%
        summarise(first_palliative_date = min(start_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
        rename(palliative_start_date = first_palliative_date)
    }
    
    # Combine
    result <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col_name))
    if (!is.null(relapse_date)) {
      result <- result %>% left_join(relapse_date, by = id_col_name)
    } else {
      result <- result %>% mutate(relapse_date = as.Date(NA))
    }
    if (!is.null(explicit_death_date)) {
      result <- result %>% left_join(explicit_death_date, by = id_col_name)
    } else {
      result <- result %>% mutate(explicit_death_date = as.Date(NA))
    }
    if (!is.null(survival_date)) {
      result <- result %>% left_join(survival_date, by = id_col_name)
    } else {
      result <- result %>% mutate(survival_date = as.Date(NA))
    }
    if (!is.null(alive_status)) {
      result <- result %>% left_join(alive_status, by = id_col_name)
    } else {
      result <- result %>% mutate(alive_yes_no = NA_character_)
    }
    if (!is.null(death_status)) {
      result <- result %>% left_join(death_status, by = id_col_name)
    } else {
      result <- result %>% mutate(death_status_legacy = NA_real_)
    }
    if (!is.null(palliative_dates)) {
      result <- result %>% left_join(palliative_dates, by = id_col_name)
    } else {
      result <- result %>% mutate(palliative_start_date = as.Date(NA))
    }
    
    result
  }
  
  # Extract survival data from both datasets
  if (exists("dat_lower") && nrow(dat_lower) > 0) {
    survival_lower <- extract_survival_data(dat_lower, "patient_id")
    survival_lower$dataset <- "Lower Tract"
  } else {
    survival_lower <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), dataset = character(0))
  }
  
  if (exists("dat_upper") && nrow(dat_upper) > 0) {
    survival_upper <- extract_survival_data(dat_upper, "patient_id")
    survival_upper$dataset <- "Upper Tract"
  } else {
    survival_upper <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), dataset = character(0))
  }
  
  survival_data <- bind_rows(survival_lower, survival_upper)
  
  # Get baseline ctDNA
  baseline_ctdna <- ctdna_long %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    arrange(ctdna_date) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(patient_id, baseline_date = ctdna_date, baseline_value = ctdna_value)
  
  # Get last ctDNA and therapy dates
  last_ctdna_dates <- ctdna_long %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(last_ctdna_date = max(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Extract last therapy dates
  extract_last_therapy_date <- function(dat, id_col_name) {
    therapy_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*(start|end).*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(therapy_cols) > 0) {
      therapy_dates_long <- dat %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_cols)) %>%
        pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "therapy_date_raw") %>%
        mutate(therapy_date = as_date_safe(therapy_date_raw)) %>%
        filter(!is.na(therapy_date)) %>%
        group_by(.data[[id_col_name]]) %>%
        summarise(last_therapy_date = max(therapy_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
      return(therapy_dates_long)
    } else {
      return(tibble(!!id_col_name := dat[[id_col_name]], last_therapy_date = as.Date(NA)))
    }
  }
  
  if (exists("dat_lower") && nrow(dat_lower) > 0) {
    last_therapy_lower <- extract_last_therapy_date(dat_lower, "patient_id")
  } else {
    last_therapy_lower <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), last_therapy_date = as.Date(character(0)))
  }
  
  if (exists("dat_upper") && nrow(dat_upper) > 0) {
    last_therapy_upper <- extract_last_therapy_date(dat_upper, "patient_id")
  } else {
    last_therapy_upper <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), last_therapy_date = as.Date(character(0)))
  }
  
  last_therapy_dates <- bind_rows(last_therapy_lower, last_therapy_upper) %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(last_therapy_date = max(last_therapy_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(last_therapy_date = ifelse(is.infinite(last_therapy_date), as.Date(NA), last_therapy_date))
  
  # Extract surgery dates (for landmark analysis from surgery)
  extract_surgery_dates <- function(dat, id_col_name) {
    surgery_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("surgery.*date|surgery_\\d+_date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(surgery_cols) > 0) {
      surgery_dates_long <- dat %>%
        select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(surgery_cols)) %>%
        pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "surgery_var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
        mutate(
          surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw),
          is_surgery_1 = str_detect(surgery_var, "surgery_1")
        ) %>%
        filter(!is.na(surgery_date)) %>%
        group_by(.data[[id_col_name]]) %>%
        summarise(
          first_surgery_date = min(surgery_date, na.rm = TRUE),
          surgery_1_date = if (any(is_surgery_1)) {
            surgery_date[is_surgery_1][1]
          } else {
            first_surgery_date
          },
          .groups = "drop"
        )
      return(surgery_dates_long)
    } else {
      return(tibble(!!id_col_name := dat[[id_col_name]], 
                   first_surgery_date = as.Date(NA), 
                   surgery_1_date = as.Date(NA)))
    }
  }
  
  if (exists("dat_lower") && nrow(dat_lower) > 0) {
    surgery_dates_lower <- extract_surgery_dates(dat_lower, "patient_id")
  } else {
    surgery_dates_lower <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), first_surgery_date = as.Date(character(0)), surgery_1_date = as.Date(character(0)))
  }
  
  if (exists("dat_upper") && nrow(dat_upper) > 0) {
    surgery_dates_upper <- extract_surgery_dates(dat_upper, "patient_id")
  } else {
    surgery_dates_upper <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), first_surgery_date = as.Date(character(0)), surgery_1_date = as.Date(character(0)))
  }
  
  surgery_dates <- bind_rows(surgery_dates_lower, surgery_dates_upper) %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(
      first_surgery_date = min(first_surgery_date, na.rm = TRUE),
      surgery_1_date = min(surgery_1_date, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      first_surgery_date = ifelse(is.infinite(first_surgery_date), as.Date(NA), first_surgery_date),
      surgery_1_date = ifelse(is.infinite(surgery_1_date), as.Date(NA), surgery_1_date)
    )
  
  # Create survival outcomes (EXACTLY as in ctDNA_Descriptive.Rmd)
  all_patients <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset) %>%
    distinct()
  
  survival_outcomes <- all_patients %>%
    left_join(baseline_ctdna, by = "patient_id") %>%
    left_join(last_ctdna_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
    left_join(last_therapy_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
    left_join(surgery_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
    left_join(survival_data, by = "patient_id") %>%
    mutate(
      time_anchor = coalesce(baseline_date, survival_date),
      relapse_date_combined = case_when(
        !is.na(relapse_date) & !is.na(palliative_start_date) ~ pmin(relapse_date, palliative_start_date, na.rm = TRUE),
        !is.na(relapse_date) ~ relapse_date,
        !is.na(palliative_start_date) ~ palliative_start_date,
        TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
      ),
      death_status_final = case_when(
        !is.na(explicit_death_date) ~ 1,
        alive_yes_no == "No" ~ 1,
        !is.na(death_status_legacy) & death_status_legacy == 1 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      death_date = case_when(
        !is.na(explicit_death_date) ~ explicit_death_date,
        alive_yes_no == "No" & !is.na(survival_date) ~ survival_date,
        alive_yes_no == "No" & !is.na(relapse_date_combined) ~ relapse_date_combined,
        death_status_legacy == 1 & !is.na(survival_date) ~ survival_date,
        TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
      ),
      max_ctdna_therapy_date = {
        result <- rep(as.Date(NA), nrow(.))
        for (i in 1:nrow(.)) {
          if (!is.na(last_ctdna_date[i]) && !is.na(last_therapy_date[i])) {
            result[i] <- pmax(last_ctdna_date[i], last_therapy_date[i])
          } else if (!is.na(last_ctdna_date[i])) {
            result[i] <- last_ctdna_date[i]
          } else if (!is.na(last_therapy_date[i])) {
            result[i] <- last_therapy_date[i]
          }
        }
        result
      },
      last_available_date = case_when(
        !is.na(survival_date) ~ survival_date,
        !is.na(max_ctdna_therapy_date) ~ max_ctdna_therapy_date,
        TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      time_to_relapse = ifelse(!is.na(relapse_date_combined) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                              as.numeric(relapse_date_combined - time_anchor) / 30.44, NA_real_),
      time_to_death = ifelse(!is.na(death_date) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                            as.numeric(death_date - time_anchor) / 30.44, NA_real_),
      time_to_last_fu = ifelse(!is.na(last_available_date) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                             as.numeric(last_available_date - time_anchor) / 30.44, NA_real_),
      relapse_event = ifelse(!is.na(relapse_date_combined), 1, 0),
      death_event = death_status_final,
      pfs_time = ifelse(relapse_event == 1 & !is.na(time_to_relapse), time_to_relapse, 
                       ifelse(!is.na(time_to_last_fu), time_to_last_fu, NA_real_)),
      os_time = ifelse(
        death_event == 1 & !is.na(time_to_death), 
        time_to_death,
        ifelse(!is.na(time_to_last_fu), time_to_last_fu, NA_real_)
      )
    )
  
  cat("Created survival_outcomes for", nrow(survival_outcomes), "patients\n")
  cat("  Patients with os_time:", sum(!is.na(survival_outcomes$os_time)), "\n")
  cat("  Patients with death_event:", sum(survival_outcomes$death_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
}

# Ensure baseline_ctdna exists
if (!exists("baseline_ctdna") || is.null(baseline_ctdna) || nrow(baseline_ctdna) == 0) {
  cat("Note: baseline_ctdna not found. Creating from ctdna_long...\n")
  if (exists("ctdna_long") && !is.null(ctdna_long) && nrow(ctdna_long) > 0) {
    baseline_ctdna <- ctdna_long %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      arrange(ctdna_date) %>%
      slice_head(n = 1) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(patient_id, baseline_date = ctdna_date, baseline_value = ctdna_value)
    cat("Created baseline_ctdna with", nrow(baseline_ctdna), "patients\n")
  } else {
    cat("Warning: ctdna_long is empty. Creating empty baseline_ctdna structure.\n")
    baseline_ctdna <- tibble(
      patient_id = character(0),
      baseline_date = as.Date(character(0)),
      baseline_value = numeric(0)
    )
  }
}

# Verify required columns exist (allow empty structures)
if (nrow(baseline_ctdna) > 0) {
  if (!"baseline_value" %in% names(baseline_ctdna)) {
    stop("Error: baseline_ctdna must have 'baseline_value' column")
  }
  if (!"patient_id" %in% names(baseline_ctdna)) {
    stop("Error: baseline_ctdna must have 'patient_id' column")
  }
} else {
  cat("Note: baseline_ctdna is empty. Required columns will be checked when data is available.\n")
}

required_surv_cols <- c("patient_id", "os_time", "death_event")
missing_surv_cols <- setdiff(required_surv_cols, names(survival_outcomes))
if (length(missing_surv_cols) > 0) {
  if (nrow(survival_outcomes) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Error: survival_outcomes missing required columns:", paste(missing_surv_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  } else {
    cat("Note: survival_outcomes is empty. Required columns will be checked when data is available.\n")
  }
}

# Check if time_anchor exists, if not create it
if (!"time_anchor" %in% names(survival_outcomes)) {
  cat("Note: time_anchor not found. Creating from baseline_ctdna...\n")
  if (nrow(baseline_ctdna) > 0) {
    survival_outcomes <- survival_outcomes %>%
      left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_date), by = "patient_id") %>%
      mutate(time_anchor = coalesce(baseline_date, as.Date(Sys.Date())))
  } else {
    survival_outcomes <- survival_outcomes %>%
      mutate(time_anchor = as.Date(NA))
  }
  cat("Created time_anchor column\n")
}

# Verify ctdna_long exists (allow empty for now, will check later if needed)
if (!exists("ctdna_long")) {
  stop("Error: ctdna_long does not exist. Please check your data file or run ctDNA_Descriptive.Rmd first.")
}

# If ctdna_long is empty, create a minimal structure to prevent errors
if (is.null(ctdna_long) || nrow(ctdna_long) == 0) {
  cat("Warning: ctdna_long is empty. Creating minimal structure to allow script to continue.\n")
  cat("  Note: Most analyses will not work without ctDNA data.\n")
  # Create minimal empty structure
  ctdna_long <- tibble(
    patient_id = character(0),
    ctdna_date = as.Date(character(0)),
    ctdna_value = numeric(0)
  )
}

# Verify survival_outcomes exists (allow empty for now)
if (!exists("survival_outcomes")) {
  stop("Error: survival_outcomes does not exist. Please check your data file or run ctDNA_Descriptive.Rmd first.")
}

# If survival_outcomes is empty, create minimal structure
if (is.null(survival_outcomes) || nrow(survival_outcomes) == 0) {
  cat("Warning: survival_outcomes is empty. Creating minimal structure.\n")
  if (exists("ctdna_long") && nrow(ctdna_long) > 0) {
    all_patients <- ctdna_long %>%
      select(patient_id) %>%
      distinct()
  } else {
    all_patients <- tibble(patient_id = character(0))
  }
  
  survival_outcomes <- all_patients %>%
    mutate(
      time_anchor = as.Date(NA),
      os_time = NA_real_,
      death_event = NA_real_,
      death_date = as.Date(NA),
      last_fu_date = as.Date(NA)
    )
}

# Create baseline_ctdna if it doesn't exist
if (!exists("baseline_ctdna") || is.null(baseline_ctdna) || nrow(baseline_ctdna) == 0) {
  cat("Note: baseline_ctdna not found. Creating from ctdna_long...\n")
  baseline_ctdna <- ctdna_long %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    arrange(ctdna_date) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(patient_id, baseline_date = ctdna_date, baseline_value = ctdna_value)
  cat("Created baseline_ctdna with", nrow(baseline_ctdna), "patients\n")
}

# Verify required columns exist
if (!"baseline_value" %in% names(baseline_ctdna)) {
  stop("Error: baseline_ctdna must have 'baseline_value' column")
}
if (!"patient_id" %in% names(baseline_ctdna)) {
  stop("Error: baseline_ctdna must have 'patient_id' column")
}

required_surv_cols <- c("patient_id", "os_time", "death_event")
missing_surv_cols <- setdiff(required_surv_cols, names(survival_outcomes))
if (length(missing_surv_cols) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Error: survival_outcomes missing required columns:", paste(missing_surv_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

# Check if time_anchor exists, if not create it

    left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_date), by = "patient_id") %>%
    mutate(time_anchor = coalesce(baseline_date, as.Date(Sys.Date())))
  cat("Created time_anchor column\n")
}
```

```{r solution2_timedependent_cox}
# ==============================
# Solution 2: Time-Dependent Cox Model
# ==============================
# This addresses the time-dependent nature of ctDNA measurements
# by allowing ctDNA status to change over time

cat("\n=== Solution 2: Time-Dependent Cox Model ===\n")

# Function to create time-dependent dataset
# Each row represents a time interval where ctDNA status is constant
create_timedep_data <- function(ctdna_long, survival_outcomes, baseline_ctdna) {
  # Start with survival outcomes - handle missing time_anchor
  if ("time_anchor" %in% names(survival_outcomes)) {
    surv_base <- survival_outcomes %>%
      select(patient_id, time_anchor, os_time, death_event) %>%
      filter(!is.na(os_time), os_time > 0, !is.na(death_event), !is.na(time_anchor))
  } else {
    # If no time_anchor, create it from baseline_ctdna
    surv_base <- survival_outcomes %>%
      left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_date), by = "patient_id") %>%
      mutate(time_anchor = coalesce(baseline_date, as.Date(Sys.Date()))) %>%
      select(patient_id, time_anchor, os_time, death_event) %>%
      filter(!is.na(os_time), os_time > 0, !is.na(death_event), !is.na(time_anchor))
  }
  
  if (nrow(surv_base) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get all ctDNA measurements with time from anchor
  ctdna_timed <- ctdna_long %>%
    left_join(surv_base %>% select(patient_id, time_anchor), by = "patient_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(time_anchor), !is.na(ctdna_date), !is.na(ctdna_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      months_from_anchor = as.numeric(ctdna_date - time_anchor) / 30.44,
      ctdna_status = case_when(
        ctdna_value == 0 ~ "Negative",
        ctdna_value > 0 ~ "Positive",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_status), ctdna_status != "Unknown", months_from_anchor >= 0) %>%
    arrange(patient_id, months_from_anchor)
  
  if (nrow(ctdna_timed) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create time intervals for each patient
  timedep_list <- list()
  
  for (pid in unique(ctdna_timed$patient_id)) {
    patient_ctdna <- ctdna_timed %>% filter(patient_id == pid)
    patient_surv <- surv_base %>% filter(patient_id == pid)
    
    if (nrow(patient_ctdna) == 0 || nrow(patient_surv) == 0) next
    
    # Get baseline status
    baseline_val <- baseline_ctdna %>% 
      filter(patient_id == pid) %>% 
      pull(baseline_value)
    
    initial_status <- if (length(baseline_val) > 0 && !is.na(baseline_val)) {
      if (baseline_val == 0) "Negative" else "Positive"
    } else {
      first(patient_ctdna$ctdna_status)
    }
    
    # Start with interval from time 0 to first measurement
    if (nrow(patient_ctdna) > 0) {
      first_measure_time <- first(patient_ctdna$months_from_anchor)
      
      intervals <- tibble(
        patient_id = pid,
        tstart = 0,
        tstop = first_measure_time,
        ctdna_status = initial_status
      )
      
      # Add intervals between measurements
      if (nrow(patient_ctdna) > 1) {
        for (i in 1:(nrow(patient_ctdna) - 1)) {
          intervals <- bind_rows(
            intervals,
            tibble(
              patient_id = pid,
              tstart = patient_ctdna$months_from_anchor[i],
              tstop = patient_ctdna$months_from_anchor[i + 1],
              ctdna_status = patient_ctdna$ctdna_status[i]
            )
          )
        }
      }
      
      # Add final interval from last measurement to end of follow-up
      last_measurement_time <- max(patient_ctdna$months_from_anchor)
      final_status <- last(patient_ctdna$ctdna_status)
      
      intervals <- bind_rows(
        intervals,
        tibble(
          patient_id = pid,
          tstart = last_measurement_time,
          tstop = patient_surv$os_time,
          ctdna_status = final_status
        )
      )
      
      # Add event indicator to final interval only
      intervals$event <- c(rep(0, nrow(intervals) - 1), patient_surv$death_event)
      
      timedep_list[[pid]] <- intervals
    }
  }
  
  if (length(timedep_list) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  timedep_data <- bind_rows(timedep_list)
  return(timedep_data)
}

# Create time-dependent dataset
timedep_data <- tryCatch({
  create_timedep_data(ctdna_long, survival_outcomes, baseline_ctdna)
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Warning: Could not create time-dependent data:", e$message, "\n")
  return(NULL)
})

# Fit time-dependent Cox model
if (!is.null(timedep_data) && nrow(timedep_data) > 0) {
  timedep_data_clean <- timedep_data %>% 
    filter(ctdna_status != "Unknown", !is.na(tstart), !is.na(tstop), tstop > tstart)
  
  if (nrow(timedep_data_clean) > 0) {
    # Check if we have both positive and negative groups
    unique_statuses <- unique(timedep_data_clean$ctdna_status)
    n_events <- sum(timedep_data_clean$event == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (length(unique_statuses) > 1 && n_events > 0) {
      timedep_cox <- tryCatch({
        coxph(
          Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ ctdna_status,
          data = timedep_data_clean
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error fitting time-dependent Cox model:", e$message, "\n")
        return(NULL)
      })
      
      if (!is.null(timedep_cox)) {
        cat("\nTime-Dependent Cox Model Results:\n")
        print(summary(timedep_cox))
        
        # Extract key results
        timedep_summary <- summary(timedep_cox)
        timedep_hr <- exp(coef(timedep_cox))
        n_coefs <- length(timedep_hr)
        timedep_ci <- tryCatch({
          ci_result <- exp(confint(timedep_cox))
          if (is.matrix(ci_result) && ncol(ci_result) == 2 && nrow(ci_result) == n_coefs) {
            rownames(ci_result) <- names(timedep_hr)
            return(ci_result)
          } else if (is.matrix(ci_result) && ncol(ci_result) == 2) {
            # Matrix but wrong number of rows - try to fix
            if (nrow(ci_result) == 1 && n_coefs == 1) {
              rownames(ci_result) <- names(timedep_hr)
              return(ci_result)
            } else {
              # Mismatch - use summary instead
              stop("Dimension mismatch in confint result")
            }
          } else if (is.vector(ci_result) && length(ci_result) == 2 && n_coefs == 1) {
            # Single coefficient, vector of length 2
            ci_matrix <- matrix(ci_result, nrow = 1, ncol = 2, 
                               dimnames = list(names(timedep_hr), c("2.5 %", "97.5 %")))
            return(ci_matrix)
          } else {
            # Unexpected format - use summary instead
            stop("Unexpected confint format")
          }
        }, error = function(e) {
          # If confint fails, use summary CI
          if (!is.null(timedep_summary$conf.int) && nrow(timedep_summary$conf.int) > 0) {
            ci_matrix <- as.matrix(timedep_summary$conf.int[, c("lower .95", "upper .95"), drop = FALSE])
            rownames(ci_matrix) <- rownames(timedep_summary$conf.int)
            # Ensure dimensions match
            if (nrow(ci_matrix) == n_coefs) {
              return(ci_matrix)
            } else if (nrow(ci_matrix) == 1 && n_coefs == 1) {
              rownames(ci_matrix) <- names(timedep_hr)
              return(ci_matrix)
            }
          }
          # Fallback: create NA matrix with correct dimensions
          ci_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_coefs, ncol = 2)
          rownames(ci_matrix) <- names(timedep_hr)
          colnames(ci_matrix) <- c("lower", "upper")
          return(ci_matrix)
        })
        timedep_pval <- timedep_summary$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Get coefficient name for positive status
        coef_name <- names(timedep_hr)[grepl("Positive", names(timedep_hr))]
        if (length(coef_name) == 0) {
          coef_name <- names(timedep_hr)[1]
        }
        
        # Safely extract HR and CI values
        hr_value <- NA_real_
        ci_lower <- NA_real_
        ci_upper <- NA_real_
        p_value <- NA_real_
        
        if (length(coef_name) > 0 && coef_name %in% names(timedep_hr)) {
          hr_value <- timedep_hr[coef_name]
        }
        
        if (length(coef_name) > 0 && is.matrix(timedep_ci) && 
            coef_name %in% rownames(timedep_ci) && ncol(timedep_ci) >= 1) {
          ci_lower <- timedep_ci[coef_name, 1]
          if (ncol(timedep_ci) >= 2) {
            ci_upper <- timedep_ci[coef_name, 2]
          }
        }
        
        if (length(coef_name) > 0 && coef_name %in% names(timedep_pval)) {
          p_value <- timedep_pval[coef_name]
        }
        
        timedep_results <- tibble(
          Approach = "Time-Dependent Cox Model",
          N_Patients = length(unique(timedep_data_clean$patient_id)),
          N_Intervals = nrow(timedep_data_clean),
          N_Events = n_events,
          HR_Positive_vs_Negative = hr_value,
          HR_CI_Lower = ci_lower,
          HR_CI_Upper = ci_upper,
          P_Value = p_value
        )
      } else {
        timedep_results <- tibble(
          Approach = "Time-Dependent Cox Model",
          N_Patients = 0,
          N_Intervals = 0,
          N_Events = 0,
          HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_,
          HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
          HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_,
          P_Value = NA_real_
        )
      }
    } else {
      cat("\nWarning: Insufficient data for time-dependent Cox model\n")
      cat("  Unique statuses:", length(unique_statuses), "\n")
      cat("  Number of events:", n_events, "\n")
      timedep_results <- tibble(
        Approach = "Time-Dependent Cox Model",
        N_Patients = length(unique(timedep_data_clean$patient_id)),
        N_Intervals = nrow(timedep_data_clean),
        N_Events = n_events,
        HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_,
        HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
        HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_,
        P_Value = NA_real_
      )
    }
  } else {
    cat("\nWarning: No valid time-dependent data after cleaning\n")
    timedep_results <- tibble(
      Approach = "Time-Dependent Cox Model",
      N_Patients = 0,
      N_Intervals = 0,
      N_Events = 0,
      HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_,
      HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
      HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_,
      P_Value = NA_real_
    )
  }
} else {
  cat("\nWarning: Time-dependent data not available\n")
  timedep_results <- tibble(
    Approach = "Time-Dependent Cox Model",
    N_Patients = 0,
    N_Intervals = 0,
    N_Events = 0,
    HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_,
    HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
    HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_,
    P_Value = NA_real_
  )
}
```

```{r solution3_landmark_analysis}
# ==============================
# Solution 3: Landmark Analysis
# ==============================
# This addresses guarantee time bias by only including patients alive at landmark time
# and classifying ctDNA status at that fixed time point

cat("\n=== Solution 3: Landmark Analysis ===\n")

perform_landmark_analysis <- function(landmark_months, ctdna_long, survival_outcomes, baseline_ctdna, anchor_type = "baseline") {
  # anchor_type can be "baseline" (from first ctDNA) or "surgery" (from definitive surgery/cystectomy)
  
  # Determine anchor date based on anchor_type
  if (anchor_type == "surgery") {
    # Use surgery date as anchor
    if ("surgery_1_date" %in% names(survival_outcomes)) {
      anchor_date_col <- "surgery_1_date"
    } else if ("first_surgery_date" %in% names(survival_outcomes)) {
      anchor_date_col <- "first_surgery_date"
    } else {
      cat("Warning: Surgery date not found. Falling back to baseline anchor.\n")
      anchor_type <- "baseline"
    }
  }
  
  if (anchor_type == "surgery" && exists("anchor_date_col")) {
    # Get patients alive at landmark time from surgery
    patients_at_landmark <- survival_outcomes %>%
      filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(death_event), !is.na(.data[[anchor_date_col]])) %>%
      mutate(
        anchor_date = .data[[anchor_date_col]],
        # Calculate os_time from surgery date
        os_time_from_surgery = ifelse(
          !is.na(death_date) & !is.na(anchor_date),
          as.numeric(death_date - anchor_date) / 30.44,
          ifelse(
            !is.na(last_available_date) & !is.na(anchor_date),
            as.numeric(last_available_date - anchor_date) / 30.44,
            NA_real_
          )
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(os_time_from_surgery), os_time_from_surgery > landmark_months) %>%
      select(patient_id, time_anchor = anchor_date, os_time, death_event, os_time_from_surgery)
  } else {
    # Use baseline ctDNA date as anchor (original approach)
    if ("time_anchor" %in% names(survival_outcomes)) {
      patients_at_landmark <- survival_outcomes %>%
        filter(!is.na(os_time), os_time > landmark_months, !is.na(death_event), !is.na(time_anchor)) %>%
        select(patient_id, time_anchor, os_time, death_event)
    } else {
      # If no time_anchor, create it from baseline_ctdna
      patients_at_landmark <- survival_outcomes %>%
        left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_date), by = "patient_id") %>%
        mutate(time_anchor = coalesce(baseline_date, as.Date(Sys.Date()))) %>%
        filter(!is.na(os_time), os_time > landmark_months, !is.na(death_event), !is.na(time_anchor)) %>%
        select(patient_id, time_anchor, os_time, death_event)
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(patients_at_landmark) == 0) {
    return(list(
      landmark_months = landmark_months,
      n_patients = 0,
      cox_model = NULL,
      data = NULL,
      results = tibble(
        Approach = if (anchor_type == "surgery") {
          paste0("Landmark ", landmark_months, " months (from surgery)")
        } else {
          paste0("Landmark ", landmark_months, " months (from baseline)")
        },
        N_Patients = 0,
        N_Events = 0,
        HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_,
        HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
        HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_,
        P_Value = NA_real_
      )
    ))
  }
  
  # Classify ctDNA status at landmark based on measurements up to landmark
  if ("time_anchor" %in% names(patients_at_landmark)) {
    ctdna_at_landmark <- ctdna_long %>%
      left_join(patients_at_landmark %>% select(patient_id, time_anchor), by = "patient_id") %>%
      filter(!is.na(time_anchor), !is.na(ctdna_date), !is.na(ctdna_value)) %>%
      mutate(
        months_from_anchor = as.numeric(ctdna_date - time_anchor) / 30.44
      ) %>%
      filter(months_from_anchor >= 0, months_from_anchor <= landmark_months) %>%
      arrange(patient_id, months_from_anchor) %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      summarise(
        # Use last measurement before/at landmark
        last_value = last(ctdna_value),
        last_status = case_when(
          last_value == 0 ~ "Negative",
          last_value > 0 ~ "Positive",
          TRUE ~ "Unknown"
        ),
        # Or use pattern: ever positive before landmark
        ever_positive = any(ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        pattern_status = case_when(
          ever_positive ~ "Ever Positive",
          !ever_positive & !is.na(last_value) ~ "Always Negative",
          TRUE ~ "Unknown"
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    # If no time_anchor, use first ctDNA date as reference
    first_dates <- ctdna_long %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      summarise(first_date = min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    
    ctdna_at_landmark <- ctdna_long %>%
      left_join(first_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
      filter(!is.na(first_date), !is.na(ctdna_date), !is.na(ctdna_value)) %>%
      mutate(
        months_from_first = as.numeric(ctdna_date - first_date) / 30.44
      ) %>%
      filter(months_from_first >= 0, months_from_first <= landmark_months) %>%
      arrange(patient_id, months_from_first) %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      summarise(
        last_value = last(ctdna_value),
        last_status = case_when(
          last_value == 0 ~ "Negative",
          last_value > 0 ~ "Positive",
          TRUE ~ "Unknown"
        ),
        ever_positive = any(ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        pattern_status = case_when(
          ever_positive ~ "Ever Positive",
          !ever_positive & !is.na(last_value) ~ "Always Negative",
          TRUE ~ "Unknown"
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
  
  # Create survival dataset from landmark time
  if (anchor_type == "surgery" && "os_time_from_surgery" %in% names(patients_at_landmark)) {
    # For surgery-based landmark, use os_time_from_surgery
    landmark_survival <- patients_at_landmark %>%
      left_join(ctdna_at_landmark, by = "patient_id") %>%
      mutate(
        # Survival time from landmark (from surgery)
        os_time_from_landmark = os_time_from_surgery - landmark_months,
        # Status at landmark
        ctdna_status_landmark = last_status
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(ctdna_status_landmark), 
             ctdna_status_landmark != "Unknown",
             os_time_from_landmark > 0)
  } else {
    # For baseline-based landmark, use original os_time
    landmark_survival <- patients_at_landmark %>%
      left_join(ctdna_at_landmark, by = "patient_id") %>%
      mutate(
        # Survival time from landmark
        os_time_from_landmark = os_time - landmark_months,
        # Status at landmark
        ctdna_status_landmark = last_status
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(ctdna_status_landmark), 
             ctdna_status_landmark != "Unknown",
             os_time_from_landmark > 0)
  }
  
  if (nrow(landmark_survival) == 0) {
    return(list(
      landmark_months = landmark_months,
      n_patients = 0,
      cox_model = NULL,
      data = NULL,
      results = NULL
    ))
  }
  
  # Check if we have both positive and negative groups
  unique_statuses <- unique(landmark_survival$ctdna_status_landmark)
  n_events <- sum(landmark_survival$death_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (length(unique_statuses) > 1 && n_events > 0) {
    # Fit Cox model from landmark time
    landmark_cox <- tryCatch({
      coxph(
        Surv(os_time_from_landmark, death_event) ~ ctdna_status_landmark,
        data = landmark_survival
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error fitting landmark Cox model:", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
      if (!is.null(landmark_cox)) {
        landmark_summary <- summary(landmark_cox)
        landmark_hr <- exp(coef(landmark_cox))
        n_coefs_landmark <- length(landmark_hr)
        landmark_ci <- tryCatch({
          ci_result <- exp(confint(landmark_cox))
          if (is.matrix(ci_result) && ncol(ci_result) == 2 && nrow(ci_result) == n_coefs_landmark) {
            rownames(ci_result) <- names(landmark_hr)
            return(ci_result)
          } else if (is.matrix(ci_result) && ncol(ci_result) == 2) {
            # Matrix but wrong number of rows - try to fix
            if (nrow(ci_result) == 1 && n_coefs_landmark == 1) {
              rownames(ci_result) <- names(landmark_hr)
              return(ci_result)
            } else {
              # Mismatch - use summary instead
              stop("Dimension mismatch in confint result")
            }
          } else if (is.vector(ci_result) && length(ci_result) == 2 && n_coefs_landmark == 1) {
            # Single coefficient, vector of length 2
            ci_matrix <- matrix(ci_result, nrow = 1, ncol = 2, 
                               dimnames = list(names(landmark_hr), c("2.5 %", "97.5 %")))
            return(ci_matrix)
          } else {
            # Unexpected format - use summary instead
            stop("Unexpected confint format")
          }
        }, error = function(e) {
          # If confint fails, use summary CI
          if (!is.null(landmark_summary$conf.int) && nrow(landmark_summary$conf.int) > 0) {
            ci_matrix <- as.matrix(landmark_summary$conf.int[, c("lower .95", "upper .95"), drop = FALSE])
            rownames(ci_matrix) <- rownames(landmark_summary$conf.int)
            # Ensure dimensions match
            if (nrow(ci_matrix) == n_coefs_landmark) {
              return(ci_matrix)
            } else if (nrow(ci_matrix) == 1 && n_coefs_landmark == 1) {
              rownames(ci_matrix) <- names(landmark_hr)
              return(ci_matrix)
            }
          }
          # Fallback: create NA matrix with correct dimensions
          ci_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_coefs_landmark, ncol = 2)
          rownames(ci_matrix) <- names(landmark_hr)
          colnames(ci_matrix) <- c("lower", "upper")
          return(ci_matrix)
        })
        landmark_pval <- landmark_summary$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Get coefficient name for positive status
        coef_name <- names(landmark_hr)[grepl("Positive", names(landmark_hr))]
        if (length(coef_name) == 0) {
          coef_name <- names(landmark_hr)[1]
        }
        
        # Safely extract HR and CI values
        hr_value <- NA_real_
        ci_lower <- NA_real_
        ci_upper <- NA_real_
        p_value <- NA_real_
        
        if (length(coef_name) > 0 && coef_name %in% names(landmark_hr)) {
          hr_value <- landmark_hr[coef_name]
        }
        
        if (length(coef_name) > 0 && is.matrix(landmark_ci) && 
            coef_name %in% rownames(landmark_ci) && ncol(landmark_ci) >= 1) {
          ci_lower <- landmark_ci[coef_name, 1]
          if (ncol(landmark_ci) >= 2) {
            ci_upper <- landmark_ci[coef_name, 2]
          }
        }
        
        if (length(coef_name) > 0 && coef_name %in% names(landmark_pval)) {
          p_value <- landmark_pval[coef_name]
        }
        
        results <- tibble(
          Approach = if (anchor_type == "surgery") {
          paste0("Landmark ", landmark_months, " months (from surgery)")
        } else {
          paste0("Landmark ", landmark_months, " months (from baseline)")
        },
          N_Patients = nrow(landmark_survival),
          N_Events = n_events,
          HR_Positive_vs_Negative = hr_value,
          HR_CI_Lower = ci_lower,
          HR_CI_Upper = ci_upper,
          P_Value = p_value
        )
      
      return(list(
        landmark_months = landmark_months,
        n_patients = nrow(landmark_survival),
        cox_model = landmark_cox,
        data = landmark_survival,
        results = results
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Return NULL model if insufficient data
  return(list(
    landmark_months = landmark_months,
    n_patients = nrow(landmark_survival),
    cox_model = NULL,
    data = landmark_survival,
    results = tibble(
      Approach = paste0("Landmark ", landmark_months, " months"),
      N_Patients = nrow(landmark_survival),
      N_Events = n_events,
      HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_,
      HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
      HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_,
      P_Value = NA_real_
    )
  ))
}

# Perform landmark analyses at 3, 6, and 12 months
# Option 1: From baseline ctDNA (original approach)
landmark_3mo <- tryCatch({
  result <- perform_landmark_analysis(3, ctdna_long, survival_outcomes, baseline_ctdna, anchor_type = "baseline")
  if (!is.list(result)) {
    stop("perform_landmark_analysis did not return a list")
  }
  result
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Warning: Could not perform 3-month landmark analysis:", e$message, "\n")
  list(landmark_months = 3, n_patients = 0, cox_model = NULL, data = NULL, 
       results = tibble(Approach = "Landmark 3 months (from baseline)", N_Patients = 0, N_Events = 0,
                       HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_, HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
                       HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_, P_Value = NA_real_))
})

landmark_6mo <- tryCatch({
  result <- perform_landmark_analysis(6, ctdna_long, survival_outcomes, baseline_ctdna, anchor_type = "baseline")
  if (!is.list(result)) {
    stop("perform_landmark_analysis did not return a list")
  }
  result
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Warning: Could not perform 6-month landmark analysis:", e$message, "\n")
  list(landmark_months = 6, n_patients = 0, cox_model = NULL, data = NULL,
       results = tibble(Approach = "Landmark 6 months (from baseline)", N_Patients = 0, N_Events = 0,
                       HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_, HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
                       HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_, P_Value = NA_real_))
})

landmark_12mo <- tryCatch({
  result <- perform_landmark_analysis(12, ctdna_long, survival_outcomes, baseline_ctdna, anchor_type = "baseline")
  if (!is.list(result)) {
    stop("perform_landmark_analysis did not return a list")
  }
  result
}, error = function(e) {

       results = tibble(Approach = "Landmark 12 months (from baseline)", N_Patients = 0, N_Events = 0,

})

# Option 2: From definitive surgery/cystectomy (if surgery dates available)
if (exists("survival_outcomes") && ("surgery_1_date" %in% names(survival_outcomes) || "first_surgery_date" %in% names(survival_outcomes))) {
  cat("\n=== Performing Landmark Analysis from Definitive Surgery/Cystectomy ===\n")
  
  landmark_3mo_surgery <- tryCatch({
    result <- perform_landmark_analysis(3, ctdna_long, survival_outcomes, baseline_ctdna, anchor_type = "surgery")
    if (!is.list(result)) {
      stop("perform_landmark_analysis did not return a list")
    }
    # Update approach name
    if (!is.null(result$results)) {
      result$results$Approach <- "Landmark 3 months (from surgery)"
    }
    result
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Warning: Could not perform 3-month landmark analysis from surgery:", e$message, "\n")
    list(landmark_months = 3, n_patients = 0, cox_model = NULL, data = NULL,
         results = tibble(Approach = "Landmark 3 months (from surgery)", N_Patients = 0, N_Events = 0,
                         HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_, HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
                         HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_, P_Value = NA_real_))
  })
  
  landmark_6mo_surgery <- tryCatch({
    result <- perform_landmark_analysis(6, ctdna_long, survival_outcomes, baseline_ctdna, anchor_type = "surgery")
    if (!is.list(result)) {
      stop("perform_landmark_analysis did not return a list")
    }
    if (!is.null(result$results)) {
      result$results$Approach <- "Landmark 6 months (from surgery)"
    }
    result
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Warning: Could not perform 6-month landmark analysis from surgery:", e$message, "\n")
    list(landmark_months = 6, n_patients = 0, cox_model = NULL, data = NULL,
         results = tibble(Approach = "Landmark 6 months (from surgery)", N_Patients = 0, N_Events = 0,
                         HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_, HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
                         HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_, P_Value = NA_real_))
  })
  
  landmark_12mo_surgery <- tryCatch({
    result <- perform_landmark_analysis(12, ctdna_long, survival_outcomes, baseline_ctdna, anchor_type = "surgery")
    if (!is.list(result)) {
      stop("perform_landmark_analysis did not return a list")
    }
    if (!is.null(result$results)) {
      result$results$Approach <- "Landmark 12 months (from surgery)"
    }
    result
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Warning: Could not perform 12-month landmark analysis from surgery:", e$message, "\n")
    list(landmark_months = 12, n_patients = 0, cox_model = NULL, data = NULL,
         results = tibble(Approach = "Landmark 12 months (from surgery)", N_Patients = 0, N_Events = 0,
                         HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_, HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
                         HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_, P_Value = NA_real_))
  })
} else {
  cat("\nNote: Surgery dates not available. Skipping surgery-based landmark analysis.\n")
  landmark_3mo_surgery <- list(landmark_months = 3, n_patients = 0, cox_model = NULL, data = NULL,
                               results = tibble(Approach = "Landmark 3 months (from surgery)", N_Patients = 0, N_Events = 0,
                                               HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_, HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
                                               HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_, P_Value = NA_real_))
  landmark_6mo_surgery <- list(landmark_months = 6, n_patients = 0, cox_model = NULL, data = NULL,
                               results = tibble(Approach = "Landmark 6 months (from surgery)", N_Patients = 0, N_Events = 0,
                                               HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_, HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
                                               HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_, P_Value = NA_real_))
  landmark_12mo_surgery <- list(landmark_months = 12, n_patients = 0, cox_model = NULL, data = NULL,
                                results = tibble(Approach = "Landmark 12 months (from surgery)", N_Patients = 0, N_Events = 0,
                                                HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_, HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
                                                HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_, P_Value = NA_real_))
}

# Final safety check - ensure all landmark results are lists
if (!is.list(landmark_3mo)) {
  landmark_3mo <- list(landmark_months = 3, n_patients = 0, cox_model = NULL, data = NULL,
                       results = tibble(Approach = "Landmark 3 months", N_Patients = 0, N_Events = 0,

}

                                        HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_, P_Value = NA_real_))
}
if (!is.list(landmark_12mo)) {

                         results = tibble(Approach = "Landmark 12 months", N_Patients = 0, N_Events = 0,
                                         HR_Positive_vs_Negative = NA_real_, HR_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
                                         HR_CI_Upper = NA_real_, P_Value = NA_real_))
}

# Summarize landmark results

if (is.list(landmark_3mo) && !is.null(landmark_3mo$cox_model)) {
```

```{r comparison_table}
# ==============================
# Comparison Table
# ==============================

# Combine results from all approaches
results_list <- list()

# Add time-dependent results if available
if (exists("timedep_results") && !is.null(timedep_results) && nrow(timedep_results) > 0) {
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- timedep_results
}

# Add landmark results if available (from baseline)
if (exists("landmark_3mo") && is.list(landmark_3mo) && !is.null(landmark_3mo$results) && nrow(landmark_3mo$results) > 0) {
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- landmark_3mo$results
}
if (exists("landmark_6mo") && is.list(landmark_6mo) && !is.null(landmark_6mo$results) && nrow(landmark_6mo$results) > 0) {
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- landmark_6mo$results
}
if (exists("landmark_12mo") && is.list(landmark_12mo) && !is.null(landmark_12mo$results) && nrow(landmark_12mo$results) > 0) {
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- landmark_12mo$results
}

# Add landmark results from surgery if available
if (exists("landmark_3mo_surgery") && is.list(landmark_3mo_surgery) && !is.null(landmark_3mo_surgery$results) && nrow(landmark_3mo_surgery$results) > 0) {
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- landmark_3mo_surgery$results
}
if (exists("landmark_6mo_surgery") && is.list(landmark_6mo_surgery) && !is.null(landmark_6mo_surgery$results) && nrow(landmark_6mo_surgery$results) > 0) {
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- landmark_6mo_surgery$results
}
if (exists("landmark_12mo_surgery") && is.list(landmark_12mo_surgery) && !is.null(landmark_12mo_surgery$results) && nrow(landmark_12mo_surgery$results) > 0) {
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- landmark_12mo_surgery$results
}

# Create comparison table
if (length(results_list) > 0) {
  comparison_results <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_Summary = ifelse(!is.na(HR_Positive_vs_Negative),
                       paste0(round(HR_Positive_vs_Negative, 2), 
                              " (", round(HR_CI_Lower, 2), "-", 
                              round(HR_CI_Upper, 2), ")"),
                       "N/A"),
    P_Value_Formatted = case_when(
      is.na(P_Value) ~ "N/A",
      P_Value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      P_Value < 0.01 ~ as.character(round(P_Value, 3)),
      TRUE ~ as.character(round(P_Value, 3))
    ),
    Addresses_Time_Dependence = case_when(
      str_detect(Approach, "Time-Dependent") ~ "Yes",
      str_detect(Approach, "Landmark") ~ "Partial",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    Addresses_Guarantee_Time_Bias = case_when(
      str_detect(Approach, "Landmark") ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Approach, N_Patients, N_Events, HR_Summary, P_Value_Formatted, 
         Addresses_Time_Dependence, Addresses_Guarantee_Time_Bias)
  
  # Format table
  comparison_table_formatted <- comparison_results %>%
    rename(
      `Approach` = Approach,
      `N Patients` = N_Patients,
      `N Events` = N_Events,
      `HR (95% CI)` = HR_Summary,
      `P Value` = P_Value_Formatted,
      `Addresses Time Dependence` = Addresses_Time_Dependence,
      `Addresses Guarantee Time Bias` = Addresses_Guarantee_Time_Bias
    )
  
  kable(comparison_table_formatted, 
        caption = "Comparison of Time-Dependent Cox Model and Landmark Analyses",
        align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                  full_width = TRUE, font_size = 11) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
    add_footnote(c("Time-Dependent Cox Model: Accounts for changes in ctDNA status over time",
                   "Landmark Analysis: Addresses guarantee time bias by only including patients alive at landmark time",
                   "HR = Hazard Ratio for Positive vs Negative ctDNA status",
                   "P < 0.05 indicates statistically significant difference"), 
                 notation = "symbol")
} else {
  cat("\nNo results available for comparison table.\n")
}
```

```{r survival_curves_landmark}
# ==============================
# Survival Curves for Landmark Analysis
# ==============================

# Create Kaplan-Meier plots for landmark analyses
create_km_plot_landmark <- function(landmark_result, title_suffix) {
  if (is.null(landmark_result$cox_model) || is.null(landmark_result$data)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  data_plot <- landmark_result$data %>%
    mutate(
      surv_time = os_time_from_landmark,
      surv_event = death_event,
      surv_group = ctdna_status_landmark
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surv_time), !is.na(surv_event), !is.na(surv_group),
           surv_time > 0)
  
  if (nrow(data_plot) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Check if we have both groups
  unique_groups <- unique(data_plot$surv_group)
  if (length(unique_groups) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Fit survival curves - create Surv object first, then fit
  surv_obj <- Surv(time = data_plot$surv_time, event = data_plot$surv_event)
  
  fit <- tryCatch({
    survfit(surv_obj ~ surv_group, data = data_plot)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error fitting survival curves:", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Check if fit is valid
  if (is.null(fit$strata) || length(fit$strata) == 0 || length(fit$strata) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create plot - ensure data_plot is in the environment
  p <- tryCatch({
    # Store data_plot in a way ggsurvplot can access it
    plot_data <- data_plot
    
    # Create plot with explicit environment
    ggsurvplot(
      fit,
      data = plot_data,
      pval = TRUE,
      pval.size = 4,
      conf.int = FALSE,
      risk.table = TRUE,
      risk.table.height = 0.25,
      risk.table.fontsize = 3.5,
      risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
      risk.table.title = "Number at risk",
      ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
      title = paste0("Landmark Analysis at ", landmark_result$landmark_months, " months", title_suffix),
      xlab = "Time from Landmark (months)",
      ylab = "Overall Survival",
      legend = "right",
      legend.title = "ctDNA Status at Landmark",
      legend.labs = sort(unique_groups),
      palette = c("#2E7D32", "#E53935")[1:length(unique_groups)],
      font.main = 12,
      font.x = 10,
      font.y = 10,
      font.tickslab = 9
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error creating survival plot with ggsurvplot:", e$message, "\n")
    cat("Attempting alternative plotting method...\n")
    # Try simpler approach without ggsurvplot
    tryCatch({
      # Use base plot as fallback
      plot(fit, 
           col = c("#2E7D32", "#E53935")[1:length(unique_groups)],
           xlab = "Time from Landmark (months)",
           ylab = "Overall Survival",
           main = paste0("Landmark Analysis at ", landmark_result$landmark_months, " months", title_suffix))
      legend("topright", legend = sort(unique_groups), 
             col = c("#2E7D32", "#E53935")[1:length(unique_groups)], lty = 1)
      return(list(plot = recordPlot()))  # Return a list to match ggsurvplot structure
    }, error = function(e2) {
      cat("Alternative plot method also failed:", e2$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  return(p)
}

# Create plots for each landmark
p_landmark_6mo <- NULL
if (is.list(landmark_6mo) && !is.null(landmark_6mo$cox_model) && !is.null(landmark_6mo$data) && nrow(landmark_6mo$data) > 0) {
  p_landmark_6mo <- tryCatch({
    create_km_plot_landmark(landmark_6mo, "")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Warning: Could not create 6-month landmark plot:", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (!is.null(p_landmark_6mo)) {
    # Handle both ggsurvplot output (list with $plot) and base plots
    if (is.list(p_landmark_6mo) && "plot" %in% names(p_landmark_6mo)) {
      print(p_landmark_6mo$plot)
    } else if (is.list(p_landmark_6mo)) {
      # ggsurvplot returns a list, print the whole thing
      print(p_landmark_6mo)
    } else {
      print(p_landmark_6mo)
    }
  }
}

p_landmark_12mo <- NULL
if (is.list(landmark_12mo) && !is.null(landmark_12mo$cox_model) && !is.null(landmark_12mo$data) && nrow(landmark_12mo$data) > 0) {

  if (!is.null(p_landmark_12mo)) {
```

```{r summary_interpretation}
# ==============================
# Summary and Interpretation
# ==============================

cat("\n=== SUMMARY AND INTERPRETATION ===\n\n")

cat("Solution 2: Time-Dependent Cox Model\n")
cat("  - Addresses: Time-dependent nature of ctDNA measurements\n")
cat("  - How: Allows ctDNA status to change at each measurement time\n")
cat("  - Advantage: Captures dynamic changes in ctDNA over time\n")
cat("  - Limitation: Does not directly address guarantee time bias\n\n")

cat("Solution 3: Landmark Analysis\n")
cat("  - Addresses: Guarantee time bias (patients must survive to landmark)\n")
cat("  - How: Only includes patients alive at fixed time point (landmark)\n")
cat("  - Advantage: Eliminates guarantee time bias by ensuring all patients survive to landmark\n")
cat("  - Limitation: Loses patients who die before landmark; choice of landmark time is somewhat arbitrary\n\n")

cat("Recommendations:\n")
cat("  1. Use landmark analysis at 6 months as PRIMARY sensitivity analysis\n")
cat("  2. Use time-dependent Cox model to explore dynamic changes\n")
cat("  3. Compare results across different landmark times (3, 6, 12 months)\n")
cat("  4. Report both approaches in manuscript with clear interpretation\n")
cat("  5. Acknowledge limitations of each approach\n")
```
